import numpy as np
# Baseline subtraction using points at 1100 and 1800 cm-1 (+/- 10 cm-1 average)
def subtract_baseline(x, y):
    # Get indices for baseline points
    mask_1100 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
    mask_1800 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)
    
    if not np.any(mask_1100) or not np.any(mask_1800):
        return y
        
    y_base_1100 = np.mean(y[mask_1100])
    y_base_1800 = np.mean(y[mask_1800])
    x_base_1100 = np.mean(x[mask_1100])
    x_base_1800 = np.mean(x[mask_1800])
    
    # Create linear baseline across the whole range
    slope = (y_base_1800 - y_base_1100) / (x_base_1800 - x_base_1100)
    intercept = y_base_1100 - slope * x_base_1100
    baseline = slope * x + intercept
    
    return y - baseline

# Normalize so that max intensity in G-band (1550-1620 cm-1) is 1
def normalize_g_band(x, y):
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    if not np.any(mask_g):
        return y
    max_val = np.max(y[mask_g])
    if max_val == 0:
        return y
    return y / max_val

# Apply to current sheet data
y1 = subtract_baseline(x, y1)
y1 = normalize_g_band(x, y1)
